name: Stock Industry Comparison Generator
description: Compares two random stocks from the S&P 500 and renders a VS video.

settings.AI_Script_Prompt-stringLE: Write a short, engaging script for a YouTube Shorts video comparing the stock performance of {company_a} and {company_b} over the last {years} years. Start by saying 'What if you invested ${investment} into {company_a} versus {company_b} {years} years ago?'. Then briefly explain why one outperformed the other. Conclude by revealing that your {company_a} investment would be worth {final_a}, while {company_b} would be worth {final_b}. Keep it under 4 sentences. IMPORTANT: Spell out all numbers and monetary amounts as words (e.g., 'two thousand dollars' instead of '$2,000') so they are spoken correctly.
